description: Minor fender bender in a mall parking lot, scratched rear bumper. Other driver exchanged details and apologised.
Connecting flight delayed 9 hours due to a technical fault. Claiming airport hotel and meals, receipts attached.
Washing machine inlet hose burst while we were at work, kitchen floor tiles and a cabinet damaged.
Scraped the left side panel against a pillar while reversing in basement parking. Photos attached.
Phone pickpocketed at a train station in Rome. Police report attached, phone purchase invoice attached.
Skidded into the road divider in heavy rain. Front bumper, headlamp and radiator need replacing. No one hurt.
House broken into while the family was away for a wedding. Laptop, TV and some jewellery taken. Police FIR filed the same day.
Severe food poisoning while travelling. Two outpatient clinic visits, tests and medicines. Bills attached.
Slow leak under the bathroom sink, only noticed once the floor tiles lifted. Plumber invoice and photos attached.
Electrical short in the kitchen started a fire that spread to the living room. The house is uninhabitable, family staying with relatives.
Hit a two-wheeler at a junction. The rider was injured and taken to hospital by ambulance. Car has front damage.
Cyclone tore off part of the roof and the bedroom ceiling collapsed. Contractor estimate attached.
Car stereo and speakers stolen overnight from outside my house. No witnesses and I lost the receipt for the speakers.
Fire destroyed most of the ground floor and contents. I need the money quickly and would prefer a cash only settlement.
Car was stolen from my friend's garage while I was travelling. There is no police report filed yet.
Dent on the rear door after another car reversed into mine at a petrol pump.
Engine caught fire while idling in traffic. Fire brigade put it out, wiring harness and bonnet damaged.
Hotel room flooded from the floor above and my suitcase and clothes were soaked.
